native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Focused original targets, not full package

findings: Original13 integration tests pass through actual CLI using owned Maildir/mbox fixtures. Cover unusual/missing dates, body-hash policies, ctime selection, too-few-header rejection and LF/CRLF equivalence.

Rejected too-few-header message remains untouched while CLI exits0. Missing/unparseable timestamp skips applicable set with warning while CLI exits0. Exit0 means completed policy run, not every input verified as deduplicated.
Explicit CRLF/LF fixture writes physical different bytes before CLI and expects one remaining mail. This is intended normalized-mail equivalence, not exact-file equality.
raw vs normalized tests vary inner whitespace and observe distinct grouping. Mail-domain behavior must remain separate from encoded-file scanner contract.
transfer_decision: Add own permanent exact-file regression for whitespace boundaries and LF/CRLF differences, preserving two true-copy partitions; do not adopt mail normalization into exact equality.
limits: 285 original focused tests, not full package/Windows/date portability qualification.
Own regression result recorded separately after native test process completes.
